_meta.purpose: Canonical 4-domain priority map for the Dispatch portal. Drives the Dispatch Sidebar V2 domain order and the eventual Dispatch Hub tile stripe palette. Mirrors PM / HR / Safety priority-map discipline while honouring Dispatch's real-time / interruption-heavy operational rhythm.
_meta.doctrine: Dispatch governance is operational velocity discipline · NOT minimalism. Red stripe reserved for the live haul-board domain because that surface owns true real-time urgency. Every non-board surface visually demotes so the board never has to compete for the operator's eye.

domains.label: Live Board
domains.rationale: Highest operational velocity surface. Owns the 5-second polling cadence and the four-signal escalation policy. The ONE red domain — true real-time urgency anchor.

domains.label: Driver Coordination
domains.rationale: Driver-side workflows. Cyan stripe carries the Dispatch chrome accent without competing with red.

domains.label: Lifecycle & Records
domains.rationale: Read-mostly records. Violet differentiates from urgent red and operational cyan; signals 'reference, not real-time'.

domains.label: Guidance & Support
domains.subline: Operator guides, password rotation, training center.
domains.rationale: Lowest-frequency Dispatch surfaces. Slate communicates 'support, not operations'.

doctrine_compliance.verbiage_doctrine: All labels and sublines pass verify_admin_copy.py — no banned phrases.
doctrine_compliance.coaching_standard: All sublines ≤14 words, sentence-cased, end with period.
doctrine_compliance.loudness: Four stripe colours total (red · cyan · violet · slate); chrome stays slate-900.
doctrine_compliance.escalation_contract: Red reserved for live-board domain + severity pills + severe-tier escalations. Status pills neutral slate.
doctrine_compliance.operational_velocity: Sidebar mount is behind ?dispatchSidebarV2=1; the 5 s polling cadence is doctrine-locked; no governance instrument may slow operator scan speed.
doctrine_compliance.auth_routing: Dispatch portal token isolated · zero /api/admin/* calls from Dispatch context.
